summary: Phase 3.7 Orion Founder Command Center — FULL PASS. 32/32 backend tests + complete frontend e2e (desktop 1920, mobile 375, founder + non-founder views). Founder briefing, all 4 draft intents (badge/widget/announcement/support_reply), moderation_risks, and 7 new read tools all route to model='orion-analytics'. Explicit-confirmation phrases ('Yes, execute', 'Confirm', 'Approve this action', 'Launch it now') each write an orion_action_logs row with approval_status=approved + short_result_summary='approval_received_but_phase37_is_draft_only' and return the 'draft-only' acknowledgement. Vague phrases ('ok','looks good','sure') correctly fall through to gpt-4o-mini and write NO action row. /api/admin/orion-logs/{queries,actions,summary} are correctly founder-only gated (tfone gets 403). Filters (user, tool, success, approval_status) all return correctly narrowed rows. Static read-only invariant verified: only writes in services/orion_analytics.py are to orion_admin_query_logs and orion_action_logs. AdminOrionLogs page renders 6 summary cards, two working tabs, inline filter bar on desktop (52px height), wraps to 2-col grid on mobile with zero horizontal overflow, tfone sees the polite refusal card.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrionLogs.jsx short-circuits at the component level when isFounder===false and never calls /api/admin/orion-logs/*. That's safe (server still enforces 403), but the review_request asked to 'verify 403 in network panel' for non-founders. Considering the server gate is independently verified in pytest TestOrionLogsEndpoints.test_founder_only_gate, this is acceptable.

routers/orion_logs.py _build_filter: passing both `intent` (which expands to {$or:[detected_intent, action_type]}) and `approval_status` works because they don't collide, but if a caller passes `intent` + `success`+`user`, the $or for intent overwrites any prior $or — defensive: merge with $and if multiple $or-needing filters get added later. Non-blocking.

routers/orion_logs.py /summary uses datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%d') + 'T00:00:00+00:00' for today bucket — this is a STRING compare against timestamp which appears to be stored as ISO string in audit rows; works because ISO strings sort lex == chrono, but consider migrating audit timestamps to BSON Date for robust range queries.

AdminOrionLogs.jsx re-issues GET on EVERY filter keystroke (filters in useEffect dep array). On a busy production log that could spam the backend — consider a 250ms debounce on the text inputs (user/tool/intent).
orion_logs router applies sort('timestamp', -1) — same string-sort caveat as above. Today this works only because timestamps are ISO-8601-formatted; document this invariant.

Founder check is duplicated in 3 places (orion_analytics._is_stealth, orion_logs._is_founder, AdminOrionLogs.jsx isFounder). All hardcode the literal 'stealth'. Centralizing into a single helper (or a `is_founder` claim on the user document / JWT) would prevent drift if the founder username ever changes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: desktop stealth, filter+reset, tab swap, mobile no-overflow, tfone refusal)
